workflow: Claim: create/move log to TASKS/in-progress/, set entry status in-progress + owner + started. Build against chained skills (router order). Close: move log to TASKS/done/ (or backlog/), fill verification + follow_ups, flip entry status + finished, update STATUS.md + summary, same commit. Commits: one commit per file (larger edits split per edit); stage with diff eyes-on; subject + reason body; local-only until the human says push. Unpushed array lists every local commit except its own carrier commit (which joins on the next update); cleared per-branch on push. Validation: id == filename, status == folder, log file must exist, STATUS counts == summary.
rules: Claim: set claimedBy={agent,since,task} + stages.<stage> to in-progress (24h lease; other instances must not steal without comment). Finish: flip stage to done + update SERVICES.md + STATUS.md in same commit. Stage vocab locked: todo|in-progress|done (maps to todo/in-progress/done cells). Path truth: localRoots below are where agents edit TODAY; future split repos named in 'repo'. Never invent paths — resolve via SKILL-EXPLORE. motive is immutable (ADR change only); inProgress/next are mutable.

Fail-fast Mongoose startup (retryAttempts: 0); Redis readiness degraded but Mongo critical
JWT verification pinned to HS256, issuer ecom-auth, audience ecom-api, 30s clock tolerance
Shared configureApp used by main and e2e tests; health routes excluded from /api/v1
Type-only Mongoose Connection import required for ESM decorator metadata
follow_ups: Resolve ecom-contracts package/version and CMS payload shapes
Implement CMS domain models, endpoints, cache invalidation, and public draft filtering

cms-svc.note: Phase 1 foundation complete (cms-svc ad792c3 + a435be6): Nest 12/Node 24 ESM bootstrap, Joi env validation, fail-fast Mongo (retryAttempts: 0), degraded Redis, /health + /health/ready, JWT/Roles guard plumbing, request-id/error envelope/cache-control, Dockerized Mongo 27018. 35 unit tests across 7 files, 5 e2e tests across 2 files, oxlint/typecheck/build clean. Production smoke: 200 healthy, 503 Mongo-down, 404 envelope; startup with Mongo down exits before serving. No CMS domain code yet. Phase 2.0 contracts started (cms-002): ecom-contracts package + CMS section catalog built/tested/packed locally; theme/nav/pages/blogs/media/events/jobs and the 1.0.0 release remain.
